#title: Be With the One, Healthy and Medicine Free
content: In an era of development, we can see that people are under the rat race for making money and commercialization which has taken us very far from nature. We feel it is very necessary that people start getting aware of saving Mother Nature. In order to do this, it is very important to preserve whatever forest cover that we have left. I am immersed in this activity.
Videos as I travel and workshops as requested
Can arrange visits to any of the known 53 Tiger Reserved in India
I will conduct trainings to corporates and industry on conservation practices
Requiring a mindset change, Zero Medicine Wisdom will ultimately free us from the shackles of the rat race
